body: Upstream github.com/dpiegdon/gittoc tagged v0.9.0 (0ad3b5a): bug fixes to the CLI (dependency validation before creating an issue, staleness check and rollback on a lost race, staging only the written paths, event-kind fixes, -F paths under the alias, dangling deps tolerated, setup hardening) and its tests; no tracker data-format change, so the gittoc branch needs no migration. Resync the vendored copy file for file, leaving out upstream's dev tooling as before (.isort.cfg, AGENTS.md, scripts/dev/, assets/gittoc_logo.png).
title: Vendored gittoc resynced to upstream v0.9.0
